lines.text: Residents of this Honduran town say it rains fish. Every year.

parts.tts: Residents of this Honduran town say it rains fish. Every year.
parts.heard: Residents of this Honduran town say it rains fish every year.

lines.text: It's Yoro. Locals call it the Yuvia de Pesses, the rain of fish.

parts.tts: It's Yoro. Locals call it the Yuvia de Pesses, the rain of fish.
parts.heard: It's Joro. Locals call it the uvia de peses, the rain of fish.

lines.text: In the mid-year rainy season, a big storm rolls in...

parts.tts: In the mid-year rainy season, a big storm rolls in...
parts.heard: in the mid-year rainy season a big storm rolls in.

lines.text: and when it clears, there are fish lying on the ground.

parts.tts: and when it clears, there are fish lying on the ground.
parts.heard: and when it clears, there are fish lying on the ground.

lines.text: Residents say it's happened for over a hundred years.

parts.tts: Residents say it's happened for over a hundred years.
parts.heard: Residents say it's happened for over a hundred years.

lines.text: Since 1998, there's even a yearly festival for it, with a parade.

parts.tts: Since nineteen ninety-eight, there's even a yearly festival for it, with a parade.
parts.heard: Since 1998, there's even a yearly festival for it, with a parade.

lines.text: But here's the strange part. The fish don't appear to fall from the sky.

parts.tts: But here's the strange part. The fish don't appear to fall from the sky.
parts.heard: But here's the strange part. The fish don't appear to fall from the sky.

lines.text: One theory is waterspouts. But the nearest ocean is about 45 miles away.

parts.tts: One theory is waterspouts. But the nearest ocean is about forty-five miles away.
parts.heard: One theory is waterspouts, but the nearest ocean is about 45 miles away.

lines.text: Another: fish from a nearby river live underground, and heavy rains wash them up.

parts.tts: Another: fish from a nearby river live underground, and heavy rains wash them up.
parts.heard: Another, fish from a nearby river live underground, and heavy rains wash them up.

lines.text: And a local legend says a priest prayed to feed the poor... and fish fell.

parts.tts: And a local legend says a priest prayed to feed the poor...
parts.heard: and a local legend says a priest prayed to feed the poor.

lines.text: Nobody has confirmed how they get there. So Yoro waits for the next storm.

parts.tts: Nobody has confirmed how they get there. So Yoro waits for the next storm.
parts.heard: Nobody has confirmed how they get there, so Yoro waits for the next storm.
